hints: Find the corresponding $y$-coordinates for each stationary point.
walkthrough:
Set $\frac{dy}{dx} = 0$ to find the stationary $x$-values:
$$3x(2 - x) = 0 \implies x = 0 \quad \text{or} \quad x = 2$$

Calculate the corresponding $y$-coordinates on the curve:
$$\text{At } x = 0: \quad y = 3(0)^2 - (0)^3 = 0 \implies (0, 0)$$
$$\text{At } x = 2: \quad y = 3(2)^2 - (2)^3 = 12 - 8 = 4 \implies (2, 4)$$

Integrate $3x^2 - x^3$ with respect to $x$:
$$\int (3x^2 - x^3)\,dx = \left[ x^3 - \frac{1}{4}x^4 \right]_0^3$$
